notes.title: New cozy casual games
notes.content:
🎉 Announcement: 4 Cozy Games Coming to Steam Next Fest – October 13!


We’re excited to share that four of our cozy, heartwarming games will be featured in Steam Next Fest (October 13, 2025)! Each one offers a unique way to relax, explore, and unwind:



🐾 Solnest – Step into solarpunk-inspired rooms and uncover over 500+ hidden cats in a mindful hidden object adventure.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3907250/Solnest/"][/dynamiclink]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571156/3bfed3220fc66de736953634860c98ae9f394bef.jpg"]

🌿 Silktrails: Cats in the Grove 2 – Return to the lush world of Silkgrove, where over 1,000 cats are waiting to be discovered across 11 hand-drawn environments.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3907990/Silktrails_Cats_in_the_grove_2/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571156/4f646d999b1d506ccc609d7cca69f34438b06826.jpg"]

🏡 Still House – A serene sandbox about building, decorating, and shaping a cozy home, where every corner tells its own quiet story.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3927820/Still_House/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571156/02801aeb565529c19dfe009f90ea3cd74369aa3c.jpg"]

🎶 Radio Heart: Lofi Hours – Chill with lofi beats, calming visuals, and light productivity tools designed to help you relax, focus, and recharge.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3927050/Radio_Heart_Lofi_Hours/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571156/60381d9921bc49d42139f35b6b3ca80cef1817b8.jpg"]

✨ Join us during Steam Next Fest to play demos, explore these worlds, and find your new cozy favorite. Wishlist now and don’t miss out!

notes.title: Update v1.2 is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here’s what’s new in this version:

🐾 Cat-saving bug that occurred after the previous update has been fixed in Levels 3 and 4. Thanks for your patience!

🔙 Back button added for smoother navigation.

🌄 Background image refreshed for a better visual experience.

🛠️ Minor stability improvements carried over from the previous update.

Thanks for all the support! Keep the feedback coming 💬

Thank you.
- Gallic Team

notes.title: Achievement Improvements & Optimization
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’ve made some updates to enhance your gameplay experience:

1. Achievements have been made easier to unlock, and overall game performance has been optimized.

notes.title: Achievement Sync Issue Resolved
notes.content:
We've addressed and resolved the Steam achievement synchronization issue. Achievements should now unlock and sync correctly.

What to Do:

1. Ensure your game is updated to the latest version.

2. If your achievements previously didn't sync, try resetting the game to trigger synchronization.

We appreciate your patience and support. Thank you for playing!
